facts.claim: Pune (IMD station 43063) receives 841.2 mm of rain a year on average over 51.3 rainy days (1991–2020).
facts.source_title: Climatological Tables of Observatories in India 1991–2020 (9th edition, 2022)
facts.note: Row I columns: station-level pressure, dry bulb, wet bulb, mean daily max, mean daily min, highest in month, lowest in month, extreme highest, date, extreme lowest, date, relative humidity (08:30 IST), vapour pressure, all clouds, low clouds, rainfall total (mm), rainy days, wettest month, driest month, heaviest 24h fall, date, wind speed. Row II repeats some fields for 17:30 IST (relative humidity in the 5th value) and extreme years.

facts.claim: June to September bring 183.9, 190.0, 156.3 and 140.4 mm, 670.6 mm in total, which is about 80% of Pune's annual 841.2 mm.
facts.source_title: Climatological Tables of Observatories in India 1991–2020 (9th edition, 2022)

facts.claim: Pune's average relative humidity is 84% at 08:30 and 77% at 17:30 in July, 86% and 79% in August, falling to 57% and 22% in March.
facts.source_title: Climatological Tables of Observatories in India 1991–2020 (9th edition, 2022)

facts.claim: April is Pune's hottest month, with an average daily maximum of 37.9 °C; the station's record is 43.3 °C.
facts.source_title: Climatological Tables of Observatories in India 1991–2020 (9th edition, 2022)

facts.claim: January nights in Pune average a minimum of 11.2 °C.
facts.source_title: Climatological Tables of Observatories in India 1991–2020 (9th edition, 2022)

facts.claim: Knight Frank recorded 24,890 homes sold in Pune in H1 2026 (up 2% year on year), 31,116 units launched (up 17%) and an average price of INR 10,063 per sq ft (up 5%).
facts.source_title: Pune records highest-ever half-year office leasing in H1 2026 (reporting Knight Frank India Real Estate H1 2026)
facts.quote: Pune continued to witness healthy end-user demand with 24,890 housing units sold during H1 2026 , a 2% YoY increase. Developers remained confident about the market outlook, launching 31,116 new housing units , reflecting a 17% YoY growth. Residential prices also continued their upward trajectory, increasing 5% YoY to an average of INR 10,063 per sq ft

facts.claim: In H1 2026 the share of Pune homes priced below INR 5 million fell, while the INR 5–10 million and 10–20 million bands took a larger share of sales.
facts.source_title: Pune records highest-ever half-year office leasing in H1 2026 (reporting Knight Frank India Real Estate H1 2026)
facts.quote: The share of homes priced below INR 5 mn declined , while the INR 5–10 mn and INR 10–20 mn categories accounted for a larger share of overall sales.

facts.claim: Knight Frank names Baner, Kharadi and Hinjewadi as locations with healthy buyer interest, citing employment centres, connectivity and projects with larger homes.
facts.source_title: Pune records highest-ever half-year office leasing in H1 2026 (reporting Knight Frank India Real Estate H1 2026)
facts.quote: Locations such as Baner, Kharadi and Hinjewadi continued to witness healthy buyer interest owing to their proximity to major employment centres, improving connectivity and projects offering larger homes and enhanced lifestyle amenities.

facts.claim: Developers in Pune are concentrating launches in the western and eastern growth corridors.
facts.source_title: Pune records highest-ever half-year office leasing in H1 2026 (reporting Knight Frank India Real Estate H1 2026)
facts.quote: with developers focusing on Pune’s western and eastern growth corridors where employment hubs and improving connectivity continue to drive demand

facts.claim: The report expects the phased rollout of Metro Line 3 between Hinjewadi and Shivajinagar, and planned metro expansion towards Kharadi and Hadapsar.
facts.source_title: Pune records highest-ever half-year office leasing in H1 2026 (reporting Knight Frank India Real Estate H1 2026)
facts.quote: including the phased rollout of Metro Line 3 connecting Hinjewadi and Shivajinagar , planned metro expansion towards Kharadi and Hadapsar

facts.claim: Pune recorded 6.6 million sq ft of office leasing in H1 2026, with Hinjawadi and Wakad in the largest office district (PBD West, 33% of transactions).
facts.source_title: Pune records highest-ever half-year office leasing in H1 2026 (reporting Knight Frank India Real Estate H1 2026)
facts.quote: Peripheral Business District (PBD) West emerged as the city’s largest office destination, accounting for 33% of transactions ... supported by large contiguous office spaces in Hinjawadi and Wakad
